scope: Exact finite control p=47,r=61,D=-19; no extrapolation to P-192 or other curves
statement: On E:y^2=x^3+x+38 over F_47 of order 61 with G=(2,1), the Legendre sign of the derivative of psi_61 at x([d]G), normalized by its value at G, equals the quadratic scalar character chi_61(d) for 28 of the 60 nonzero scalars; d=4 is a counterexample. The rational-line kernel polynomial derivative has the same 28/60 count.
